title: MuJoCo vs PhysX/SAPIEN cross-physics agreement (conceptual alignment)

mujoco_evidence: results/heb_sweeps_dev.json (internal HEB 0.1.0 insertion_offset_m sweep, 9 cells 0.5-4.3mm, mediated vs bare paired)

alignment_limits.declared_upfront: The two tracks are conceptually aligned (peg insertion, mediation on/off paired), NOT environment-equivalent: different simulators, geometries (internal 5mm-scale peg vs ManiSkill box-side insertion), perturbation axes (commanded offset vs initial-realization deviation), and force measurement (MuJoCo sensor-class force vs PhysX last-substep impulse-derived proxy). Section 20 of the campaign: no exact force equivalence is claimed or tested.

task_outcome_agreement.mujoco_offset_sweep: 9/9 cells: mediated and bare graded identically (COMPLETE/ABORTED) at every commanded offset; boundary 3.0->3.5mm is the SAME for both arms
task_outcome_agreement.physx_perturbation_sweep: 12/12 seeds: direct and mediated success/failure classification identical (1/12 success at recorded state, 0/12 off-distribution)

method_ranking_agreement.statement: Haplous does not reverse the direct-vs-mediated success ranking on either engine
method_ranking_agreement.mujoco: mediated == bare at every cell (no ranking change; success preserved where bare succeeds)
method_ranking_agreement.physx: direct == mediated on task success at every seed (no ranking change; failure preserved where direct fails)

failure_class_agreement.physx: off-distribution both arms FAIL, but the failure CLASS diverges by design: direct = unbounded timeout with 336-2115N peaks and 31-42deg tilt; mediated = bounded ABORT on declared hard constraint (force 3x, tilt 8x), peaks 0-432N. Divergence is in boundedness, not in outcome classification.
failure_class_agreement.mujoco: at the boundary both arms ABORT identically (same cell); below boundary both COMPLETE with 0 violations

boundary_displacement.mujoco: ZERO displacement: mediated and bare share the 3.0->3.5mm capture boundary exactly
boundary_displacement.physx: not measurable on this axis (single frozen stream; the axis is initial-realization deviation, and only the dev=0 cell is on-distribution). No boundary displacement claim is made.

force_magnitude_comparison.detail: MuJoCo seated F_z ~15N (sensor-class) vs PhysX impulse-proxy peaks 3.4N (on-distribution post-seat) and up to 2115N (off-distribution timeout). Different measurement definitions and different contact regimes; only within-engine direct-vs-mediated ratios are meaningful.

conclusions: VERIFIED FACT (within committed data): semantic outcome agreement is 100% on both engines - mediation never flips a success into a failure or vice versa at the task-outcome level in these suites.

VERIFIED FACT: boundedness improvements replicate across engines: where an accepted/continued execution exceeds declared bounds, mediation caps it (MuJoCo force-limit scenarios in prior campaign; PhysX post-seat excursion 42N->3.4N on-distribution, 2115N->432N worst-case off-distribution).

INFERENCE (limited): cross-physics ranking preservation supports engine-independence of the mediation semantics, but the evidence base is 2 engines x 1-2 task families; broader generalization remains UNKNOWN.
